newsitem.title: USA: Intraday CSCE world sugar lower and still in range.
newsitem.headline: Intraday CSCE world sugar lower and still in range.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures retraced some of the gains made during the previous session and eased below unchanged by midday.

Prices remained well within their recent trading range amid thin volume. Dealers said the benchmark May contract will need to pierce 11.10 cents a lb on the upside, or support pegged at 10.68 cents, in order to break out of its current range.
But the light trade buying that pressured prices today is not likely to push the contract below support in the near term, they said.
Volume as of 1100 EST was estimated at only 4,751 lots.
"There is some trade selling but it is very, very quiet here today. It's the same old story," a trading source said.
At 1130 EST, May was 0.07 cent lower at 10.83 cents, traded from 10.92 to 10.81 cents. The outer contracts were 0.01 to 0.05 lower.
Open interest in most-active May fell 1,348 lots to 62,253 lots as of Thursday's close.
